source_review: Block index selects node through nodes[start+blockIdx.x]. Persistent addressing uses node/child IDs or explicit slots.
Down action writes child actor reach. For every level, (actor,slot) writes must be unique and disjoint from all corresponding input rows. Player buffers are separate.
Up action/eval writes node CFV and reads child CFVs. All current-level writes must be unique and disjoint from child inputs, including terminal/parity caches.
Regret/strategy intervals use node_data_off,na,nh and must be disjoint per actor and within arena bounds.
Within-node FP order, child order, terminal/chance phases and stream boundaries are unchanged. Action kernels have no cross-node atomics.
